evidence.name: Screen field: How media meets the text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How media meets the text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How media meets the text
sections.description: Sets how the media and the paywall text relate vertically. 'Above Content' keeps the media as a banner with the title, subtitle, and plans stacked below it (safest, always readable); 'Behind Intro Content' layers the title over the media for a magazine-style hero. Start with Above Content; if you choose the overlaid look, turn on the gradient overlay so the text stays legible.
